evidence.evidence: Cast your mind back to January and you might remember a sit-down we had with some of the leaders of a newly-independent GOG . The DRM-free storefront had separated from its former owner—CD Projekt—and returned to the arms of its original cofounder, Michał Kiciński. Back then, Kiciński told us that publishing was one of the several moves GOG was considering in its post-CDP life. Well, the day has finally come.

So it was probably a relatively easy marriage to make happen: "With GOG now under the ownership of its original co-founder, Michał Kiciński, who also co-founded Retrovibe, the two companies have an opportunity to work more closely together," says the announcement, touting Retrovibe's publishing nous and GOG's "platform expertise, marketing capabilities and connection to PC players worldwide."

evidence.evidence: Their previous work, *The Starving: A Thousand-Li Journey at the End of the Ming Dynasty* (hereinafter referred to as *The Starving*), sold over a million copies. Its sequel, *The Wailing*, however, has been mired in controversy since its inception.It began with the game’s setting—against the backdrop of the “Ten Days of Yangzhou,” a massacre that took place during the late Ming Dynasty, the player assumes the role of a scholar engaged in a “romance between a scholar and a courtesan”—with both female protagonists portrayed as women of the night.As the game officially launched, controversial memes derived from snippets of in-game dialogue spread virally across various QQ groups and online communities.

According to his account, prior to the game’s release, Ji Ling had already anticipated the various chain reactions that *Ai Hong* might trigger. For example, he expected even more intense controversy than that surrounding *E Shu*—though the actual scale of the controversy ultimately fell only slightly short of his expectations;for instance, a potential decline in sales—*Aihong* sold approximately 40,000 copies on its first day, recouping its costs, and current sales have exceeded 80,000 copies, surpassing those of *Eshu* during the same period. However, based on their projections, sales over the next two years are expected to fall somewhat short of *Eshu*’s figures.

evidence.evidence: 全球游戏服务提供商Side于10月21日正式宣布，收购成都精品游戏美术工作室Roboto Entertainment，并以此为基础成立Side成都工作室。这是Side继上海之后在中国大陆设立的第二个站点，也是其全球美术业务一次关键的战略补强。

从业务布局看，Side此前已向中国开发者提供完整的服务套件，包括玩家支持、QA、本地化、LQA、数据集、联合开发、美术和音频。Side的美术团队（前身为1518 Studios）拥有超过500名美术师，曾参与《无主之地》系列、《幽灵行者 2》、《木卫四协议》、《守望先锋 2》等项目。但此前Side的美术能力更多集中在角色美术侧，环境与世界观构建恰是Roboto的专长所在。成都工作室的加入，补上了这块拼图，使Side在中国市场的服务链条更加完整。

evidence.evidence: GameLook报道/大多数爆款手游都能火两三年，但《地铁跑酷》却即将迎来15周年，它是史上下载量最高的手游，每月仍有1亿到1.5亿左右的用户量。他2014年加入SYBO，2017年接任CEO一职。在游戏发展的这段时间里，Mathias Gredal Nørvig一直负责其运营工作，他于2017年担任SYBO的首席执行官。

Mathias Gredal Nørvig： 如我所说，上线这么多年之后每个月仍能为这么多人提供娱乐，我们估计MAU在1亿到1.5亿之间，这是现象级的。推出《城市》，我们是希望看一款现代免费游戏能够提供哪些《地铁跑酷》所没有的东西。于是，我们决定追求更高的分辨率、更多的自定义选项，让我们允许玩家通过反复游玩深入了解游戏机制，从而不断提升角色能力，获得不同的特性和技能，以便以不同的方式完成不同关卡。因此，与《地铁跑酷》的玩法也不同。

evidence.evidence: A 27 de fevereiro, o novo jogo da Bungie, «Lost Star Ship: Marathon» (doravante designado por «Marathon»), deu início a um «teste de carga do servidor» gratuito.Embora nos últimos dias todos tenham estado a discutir o quão elegante o Leon é em «Resident Evil 9», muitas pessoas optaram por experimentar este novo jogo da Bungie, fruto de dez anos de trabalho, incluindo o autor deste artigo.

evidence.evidence: Afinal, as expectativas em relação à Bungie são essas. Nas apresentações anteriores, «Marathon» chamou bastante a atenção graças ao seu estilo original de ficção científica ácida.A expectativa geral é que, como um dos «pioneiros dos FPS ocidentais» que, com as séries «Halo» e «Destiny», revolucionou por duas vezes a forma de conceber os FPS ocidentais, ao entrar no tão cobiçado género de «search-and-destroy», a Bungie tenha de trazer algo de novo e realmente empolgante, não é?

evidence.evidence: Na prática, o desenrolar dos acontecimentos após o lançamento foi mais ou menos assim: em apenas algumas horas, o número de jogadores simultâneos do «Marathon» no Steam atingiu um pico de 140 mil, e as pré-vendas do jogo chegaram ao Top 3 da tabela de mais vendidos do Steam. No entanto, no segundo e terceiro dias seguintes, apesar de ser fim de semana, o número de jogadores online no Steam caiu rapidamente para metade.A classificação na PlayStation Store ficou-se nos 3/5 pontos, e as reações nas redes sociais tornaram-se polarizadas — e isto mesmo tendo em conta que o teste era gratuito.

evidence.evidence: At just about 15 hours into Phantom Blade Zero, I've changed out my primary weapons more times than I do in an entire Souls campaign. I quickly dropped my starter sword for a pair of dual blades and a jagged weapon that chunks damage off my enemies in showers of blood. But I didn't stick with either for long. Soon I was running around with a two-handed blade taller than my martial arts hero Soul, which sprouts a trail of magical, energy-sapping flowers with every swing. It shares a moveset with another two-handed giant that absorbs life with each hit. But I don't have time to use either one: I'm already smitten with my new twin blades, one of which I can send spinning in a circle around me like a protective Beyblade.

evidence.evidence: 邹珈璇是网易祝融工作室总经理，玩家更为熟悉的是他的ID“听雨”。他先在《逆水寒》端游担任主策，后担任《逆水寒》手游制作人。《逆水寒》作为一款影响力巨大，相对带有MMORPG游戏精髓，但同时又始终探索各种新突破的游戏，回答这些问题显然是合适的。触乐和他的对话也围绕着“MMORPG现在已经式微了吗？是什么导致了MMORPG今天的境况？”开始。邹珈璇认为，传统MMO确实面临挑战，但通过沉浸的世界塑造和角色扮演Fantasy，更高的游戏品质与玩法、内容和玩家生态的持续创新，这一品类仍有广阔的可能。他仍然对MMO的未来抱有坚定的信心。

evidence_anchors.evidence: Finally, let’s talk trends. Before the October Next Fest, I’d predicted we’d see just over 5,000 demos, which would continue the trend line. And… nope. Although some demos were pulled late, we still got to >7,300, up 66.6% (!) on June 2026’s ~4,400:

We use Steam follower increase here, since it enables us to benchmark to more Next Fests, and: a game in the top 10% of all Oct. Steam Next Fest titles added +63 followers (so +1,500 wishlists, maybe?), down 48% compared to June (+121 followers) and down 64% on Oct. 2025 (+173 followers.) That’s fairly representative of all tiers…

Part of the point here is - people already cared about these games way before Next Fest. (We estimate Frostrail already had 650k+ wishlists, for example.) But how many of you were following it closely? And that’s the point of Next Fest - it’s not a hype originator for most games, so much as a hype amplifier….

evidence.evidence: Eight years after its reveal, magical cozy game Witchbrook finally has a release date. We’ve been waiting a painfully long time for this Kiki’s Delivery Service-inspired pixel-art experience to break cover, and now we finally know it will be coming to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on January 28, 2027. So you’ll have plenty of time to complete GTA 6 before diving into this severe tonal shift.

genre_assessment.basis: 本事件有明确竞技/重点品类证据，标签不叠加。

evidence.evidence: At first glance, Witchbrook seems like yet another comfortable life sim along the same lines as Coral Island, Stardew Valley, Story of Seasons, and countless others. The genre is super popular, so developers need to do something incredibly impressive in order to stand out. I’m a sucker for these games even if they don’t push the boat out, but Witchbrook seems awfully determined to innovate on the cozy genre.

According to statistics from DianDian Data, in the half-month period from its launch through March 29, the game has amassed 3.6 million cumulative downloads on the iOS platform alone, with revenue exceeding 13 million yuan—a truly impressive performance in the casual strategy “mow-’em-up” genre.

evidence.evidence: The October Edition of Steam Next Fest was, unsurprisingly, a complete mess . What was once a fun week-long festival of early game demos has become a dumping ground for vibe-coded AI slop, making it increasingly hard to find and wishlist good games. And if you weren't bothered by playing a game demo that was hastily cobbled together, the sheer volume--around 7,100 game demos were available this time--of what was on offer made Next Fest a nightmare to navigate. So what's a person to do when Valve's own storefront lacked the tools to separate the wheat from the chaff? Be patient, and look at the general consensus; that's what.

evidence.evidence: 访谈背景： 从 70 年代末开始，中国主机游戏的研发历史一直处于灰色地带，即：盗版、非授权开发，偶有少量的代工。直到 2004 年，由上海育碧自研的主机游戏《细胞分裂 2：明日潘多拉》在全球销售数百万套，才标志着中国主机游戏的研发能力达到了国际水准。本次接受访谈的沈黎老师于 1997 年进入上海育碧，2007 年在上海育碧完成《细胞分裂 4》后离开，见证了中国主机游戏进入工业化时代的关键过程。如今，沈老师成立的“铼三实验室”正在从事游戏行业的早期投资，对 AI 时代下的游戏立项和风险投资也有着深刻的认识。本次访谈中，沈老师分享了他在上海育碧和风险投资领域的经历，帮助我们重新梳理中国单机游戏从 2000 年初到现在，从工业化时代到 AI 时代的变化。

evidence.evidence: Den größten Anteil an diesem weltweiten Hype hatten zweifellos die chinesischen Spieler. Genauer gesagt war es ein Live-Video des Bilibili-Uploaders Wang Laoju, das die Zuschauer dazu veranlasste, das Spiel zu kaufen, was schließlich zu dem Phänomen führte, dass der Anteil der Verkäufe in China bereits vor der Lokalisierung bei 43 % lag. Danach verbreitete sich der gute Ruf des Spiels weltweit.Innerhalb von acht Monaten wurden 1 Million Exemplare verkauft, doch das zweiköpfige Team ruhte sich darauf nicht aus. Mit einer extrem hohen Frequenz bei der Behebung von Fehlern und der Einführung neuer Karten verbesserten sie das Spiel kontinuierlich weiter. Selbst nach der Veröffentlichung der offiziellen Version im Januar 2019 führten sie noch im Jahr 2020 den letzten Charakter, den „Beobachter“, ein. Zudem waren sie äußerst kreativitätsfreundlich,unterstützten Mods im Creative Workshop nach Kräften und nahmen selbst aktiv Anpassungen am Spielbalancierung vor, was schließlich zur Entstehung der Legende „Slay the Spire“ als Roguelite-Kartenspiel führte.

evidence.evidence: O mérito pelo enorme sucesso global desta geração do jogo deve-se, sem dúvida, aos jogadores chineses. Mais concretamente, foi um vídeo de transmissão ao vivo do criador de conteúdo Wang Laoju, da Bilibili, que atraiu os espectadores a comprar o jogo em massa, o que acabou por resultar no fenómeno de as vendas na China representarem já 43% do total, mesmo antes da localização. Posteriormente, a reputação do jogo começou a espalhar-se por todo o mundo.Venderam 1 milhão de cópias em apenas 8 meses, mas a equipa de duas pessoas não se acomodou. Continuaram a aperfeiçoar o jogo com uma frequência extremamente elevada na correção de bugs e no lançamento de novas cartas, e mesmo após o lançamento da versão oficial em janeiro de 2019, lançaram ainda em 2020 a personagem final, «O Observador». Além disso, demonstraram-se extremamente favoráveis aos criadores,apoiando fortemente os mods da Workshop e realizando ativamente ajustes de equilíbrio, o que acabou por dar origem a «Slay the Spire», este lendário jogo de cartas do género roguelike.

Este jogo, aclamado por ter definido todo o subgénero dos jogos roguelike de construção de baralhos, graças à sua qualidade excecional e à excelente capacidade da comunidade de jogadores para criar memes,tem sido, nos últimos anos, um habitual no top 5 da lista de desejos do Steam. Já antes do lançamento, havia a preocupação de que, tal como aconteceu com «Knight of the Void: Song of the Thread», os servidores pudessem ficar sobrecarregados no momento do lançamento — e foi exatamente isso que aconteceu. A plataforma ficou inoperacional a partir da 1h50, só voltando a estabilizar por volta das 3h,o que demonstra o enorme entusiasmo dos jogadores.

evidence.evidence: Sin duda, el mérito de este éxito mundial recae en gran medida en los jugadores chinos de la primera generación; más concretamente, en un vídeo de retransmisión en directo del creador de contenido de Bilibili Wang Laoju, que atrajo a tantos espectadores que estos se lanzaron a comprar el juego, lo que acabó dando lugar al fenómeno de que, incluso antes de su localización, las ventas en China ya representaban un 43 % del total. Además, se mostraron extremadamente favorables hacia los creadores,apoyaron en gran medida los mods del Creative Workshop y realizaron ellos mismos ajustes de equilibrio de forma activa, lo que finalmente dio lugar a «Slay the Spire», este legendario juego de cartas de tipo roguelike.

Wie bei dieser Pressekonferenz bekannt gegeben wurde, wird es zum offiziellen Start vor allem zwei Modi geben: 1v1 und 4v4.Im erstgenannten Modus können die Spieler ihre beiden Resonanzen frei kombinieren und verfügen über exklusive Beschwörerfähigkeiten und Talente. Der zweite Modus konzentriert sich hingegen auf ein kooperatives Multiplayer-Spiel, bei dem vier Spieler ein Fahrzeug zum Ziel eskortieren müssen, während die gegnerische Mannschaft dies innerhalb einer vorgegebenen Zeit verhindern soll. Auch in Zukunft wird der Entwickler das PVP-Erlebnis durch vielfältige Updates kontinuierlich erweitern.

evidence.evidence: Tomemos como ejemplo a «Sun Quan», el nuevo héroe que causó sensación durante la temporada de verano del año pasado. Según la concepción tradicional, los tiradores no son más que personajes que se quedan fijos en un lugar para infligir daño o que se dedican a desgastar al enemigo con tácticas de «kiting». Sin embargo, a Sun Quan se le ha dotado de un mecanismo de cambio entre dos formas: «disparo rápido con arco corto» y «bandera militar para reforzar las defensas».Esto no solo supone una pequeña innovación en la jugabilidad, sino también una interpretación precisa de los rasgos del personaje histórico: la reducción de daño de su pasiva «Bloqueando el sureste» es una metáfora de su sólida base defensiva en Jiangdong, mientras que el poder de daño explosivo en combate cuerpo a cuerpo de su habilidad definitiva recrea la valentía que demostró al liderar personalmente la campaña contra Hefei.

evidence.evidence: Zweitens verfügen wir über ein Entwicklungsteam von mehr als 1.000 Mitarbeitern sowie eine umfangreiche Bibliothek an Spielressourcen. Diese Ressourcen bieten eine solide visuelle Grundlage und ausgereifte Materialien für die Erstellung von UGC. Darüber hinaus hat das Team bereits verschiedene Spielmodi in das Spiel integriert, um die Inhalte abwechslungsreich zu gestalten und den Bedürfnissen unterschiedlicher Spieler gerecht zu werden.Wie das in der Präsentation gezeigte Rahmenkonzept verdeutlicht, können Spieler auf der Grundlage der Originalinhalte von „Genshin Impact“ ihre eigene Welt erschaffen – sei es im Stil von „Denggehu“, der auf Heilung und Entspannung ausgerichtet ist, im kampfbetonten Spielmodus „Shen Gong Tian Qiao“ oder im Typ „Qian Yin Ya Ji“, bei dem der Schwerpunkt auf geschickten Herausforderungen liegt.

evidence.evidence: Die Zuversicht, diese Rolle übernehmen zu können, beruht nicht nur auf der Qualität des Produkts selbst, sondern auch auf der Erfahrung des Entwicklungsteams SUPER CREATIVE im Bereich des langfristigen Betriebs sowie auf der Nachhaltigkeit des Engagements.Betrachtet man die internationale Version „Star Gazing“, so wurde auf der diesjährigen Vorab-Pressekonferenz bereits die Update-Strategie für das gesamte Jahr 2026 festgelegt, deren Schwerpunkt auf der Bereicherung des Gameplays, der Stärkung saisonaler Elemente und der Verbesserung der inhaltlichen Vollständigkeit liegt.Diese Planungen zeigen, dass SUPER CREATIVE das langfristige Potenzial und die Spieltiefe des Produkts systematisch erweitert, was für die chinesische Serverversion zweifellos ein beruhigendes Zeichen in Bezug auf den Betrieb darstellt.

Because Arkane is based in France, Xbox couldn't just drop the hammer on it. Instead, it began a legally-required consultation process "to review potential strategic options."

evidence.evidence: Unfortunately, there are also some huge downsides that have repeatedly surfaced over the course of the WoW: Forever beta. It doesn't take much searching on YouTube or Reddit to find countless instances of players complaining about layering. Leaving a group, crossing into a different zone, or traveling on a zeppelin or boat causes players to abruptly switch layers. The layering changes feel far more frequent and noticeable than in the past, ruining some of the charm that comes from having a persistent world filled with the same people.

evidence.evidence: Multi-AP Coexistence is a category of technologies that describes how nearby routers can work together: Coordinated Beamforming (Co-BF) enables multiple access points to exchange information and map out the fastest, most-efficient channels to devices. Coordinated Spatial Reuse (Co-SR) sees nearby wireless access points adjust transmission power dynamically, allowing them to transmit on the same channel simultaneously without drowning each other out. Coordinated Time-Division Multiple Access (Co-TDMA) sees neighbouring routers agree upon dividing up (and sharing) transmission slots to benefit everyone, instead of fighting for bandwidth. Non-Primary Channel Access (NPCA) lets an access point use secondary (sub) channels, if the primary channel gets blocked. Seamless Multi-Link Operation (Seamless MLO) facilitates smoother roaming across wireless nodes. This all makes wireless networks faster and more reliable in crowded environments.

evidence.evidence: 10月19日，Saber Interactive首席执行官Matthew Karch在领英发文称赞《克里夫·巴克 猛鬼追魂：复苏》的开发团队，并透露这款游戏自10月8日发售以来，在PC和主机平台上的表现「非常出色」。他还推测，拥有巨额预算、开发周期漫长的AAA游戏或许无法在行业中持续太久——如果它们如今真的还能持续的话。相较之下，基于成熟IP、预算更低的AA游戏可能才是更现实的发展方向。他写道：「这款游戏证明，成熟IP加上扎实的AA级开发和受控成本，能够带来出色的成果与较高的玩家评分。我认为，游戏行业未来要维持增长势头，就应当更加关注这类由IP驱动的中端市场产品，而不是AAA巨作。我相信，只要开发和预算规划得当，AAA游戏体验始终会有一席之地。但一款以更低价格提供出色沉浸式体验的AA游戏，风险更低，平均而言也能带来高得多的回报。」

evidence.evidence: Wildlight 스튜디오가 개발한 《Highguard》는 1월 27일 스팀에 정식 출시되었다. 출시 첫날 최고 동시 접속자 수는 10만 명에 육박했으나, 이틀도 채 지나지 않아 1만 명 정도로 떨어졌고, 출시 한 달이 지난 후에는 700명에 그쳤다.특히 주목할 점은, Wildlight 스튜디오가 웰치(Welch)와 리스폰(Respawn)의 베테랑 개발자 몇 명이 공동으로 설립했으며, 구성원 대부분도 리스폰 엔터테인먼트 출신으로 배틀로얄 게임 《Apex》를 직접 제작한 팀이라는 사실이다. 그들은 《Highguard》를 통해 과거의 성공을 재현하고자 했으나, 여러 가지 이유로 인해 이 논란 많은 게임은 결국 허무하게 막을 내리고 말았다.

subject_assessment.basis: Side跨美洲、EMEA和亚洲服务网络、逾500名美术师及多款AAA项目参与证明其具有较强行业影响力；收购及全球负责人任命E3R2。

evidence.evidence: 全球游戏服务提供商Side于10月21日正式宣布，收购成都精品游戏美术工作室Roboto Entertainment，并以此为基础成立Side成都工作室。这是Side继上海之后在中国大陆设立的第二个站点，也是其全球美术业务一次关键的战略补强。

从业务布局看，Side此前已向中国开发者提供完整的服务套件，包括玩家支持、QA、本地化、LQA、数据集、联合开发、美术和音频。Side的美术团队（前身为1518 Studios）拥有超过500名美术师，曾参与《无主之地》系列、《幽灵行者 2》、《木卫四协议》、《守望先锋 2》等项目。但此前Side的美术能力更多集中在角色美术侧，环境与世界观构建恰是Roboto的专长所在。成都工作室的加入，补上了这块拼图，使Side在中国市场的服务链条更加完整。

evidence.evidence: En el pasado, la representación de las guerras en los videojuegos online de producción nacional solía reducirse a una breve descripción o a unas secuencias generadas por ordenador. La razón es que el personaje que interpreta el jugador es solo un individuo, por lo que le resulta muy difícil hacer frente a la imponente marea de una guerra a gran escala.Sin embargo, como se puede apreciar en la batalla de Zhongduqiao, el equipo de desarrollo de Yan Yun quiere desafiar la tradicional «paradoja de la expresividad en el género de las artes marciales y la guerra» y, mediante un enfoque coral y un juego de rol multidimensional, permite a los jugadores participar de forma activa en cada uno de los aspectos del juego.Al reducir la grandiosa visión de la historia de los héroes a una microcosmos de la historia del pueblo, se interpreta verdaderamente la esencia de las artes marciales chinas: «El verdadero caballero es aquel que se entrega a la patria y al pueblo».

evidence.evidence: Durante mucho tiempo, la «fórmula para el éxito de un lanzamiento» en la industria de los videojuegos parecía estar bien establecida: un producto de calidad, un elevado presupuesto para la adquisición de usuarios y espacios publicitarios de categoría S bastaban para generar una curva de usuarios activos diarios (DAU) espectacular durante el periodo de lanzamiento.Sin embargo, ante el éxito fenomenal que ha supuesto recientemente la versión china de «Goose Duck Kill» —con 10 millones de usuarios nuevos en seis días y más de 100 millones de visualizaciones de contenido relacionado en Douyin en 24 horas—, esta lógica tradicional de lanzamiento está sufriendo una cierta disrupción.

subject_assessment.subject: SYBO
subject_assessment.basis: 来源证明49亿累计下载、1亿至1.5亿月活及长期全球移动产品经营规模，SYBO为名单外同等影响力手游主体；经营数据E2R3。

evidence.evidence: GameLook报道/大多数爆款手游都能火两三年，但《地铁跑酷》却即将迎来15周年，它是史上下载量最高的手游，每月仍有1亿到1.5亿左右的用户量。他2014年加入SYBO，2017年接任CEO一职。在游戏发展的这段时间里，Mathias Gredal Nørvig一直负责其运营工作，他于2017年担任SYBO的首席执行官。

Mathias Gredal Nørvig： 如我所说，上线这么多年之后每个月仍能为这么多人提供娱乐，我们估计MAU在1亿到1.5亿之间，这是现象级的。推出《城市》，我们是希望看一款现代免费游戏能够提供哪些《地铁跑酷》所没有的东西。于是，我们决定追求更高的分辨率、更多的自定义选项，让我们允许玩家通过反复游玩深入了解游戏机制，从而不断提升角色能力，获得不同的特性和技能，以便以不同的方式完成不同关卡。因此，与《地铁跑酷》的玩法也不同。
